description: Defines the InflateStream class implementing StreamInterface, which wraps a stream and applies zlib.inflate filtering for decompressing zlib or gzipped content, used in handling HTTP message streams.

classes.name: InflateStream
classes.description: A stream decorator that inflates compressed stream data using zlib.inflate filter, conforming to PSR-7 StreamInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an InflateStream by wrapping the provided StreamInterface and applying a zlib.inflate stream filter with header detection for decompressing zlib or gzipped content.
